design.summary: New module service/api/bulk.py with POST /api/v1/urls/bulk. Reuses LinkService.create per item (same validation, SSRF guard and alias rules) and the existing rate limiter per item. Response 200 with per-item results.

components.name: BulkCreateRequest / BulkItemResult / BulkCreateResponse
components.responsibility: Typed contract, 1-100 items, extra fields forbidden

adr.title: ADR-002: Partial success with 200 and per-item results
adr.context: Campaign imports contain some bad URLs; all-or-nothing would force clients to pre-validate and retry whole batches.
adr.decision: Process items independently and return 200 with per-item status; reject only structurally invalid batches with 422. 207 Multi-Status was rejected as WebDAV-specific.
adr.consequences: Clients must inspect results; counts make that easy. No transaction spans the batch.

design.test_strategy: Integration tests through TestClient for all-success, mixed failures (SSRF, duplicate alias), size limits, extra fields, and per-item rate limiting; contract test covers the OpenAPI change.

decisions.rationale: Keeps routes.py focused on single-link ops
